candidates.change_summary: Change the first conditional to update _BASE_TARGET_ and _QUOTE_TARGET_ only when _BASE_RESERVE_ > _BASE_TARGET_ (flipped comparison), so _BASE_TARGET_ may remain different after correctRState.
Change the second conditional to update _BASE_TARGET_ and _QUOTE_TARGET_ only when _QUOTE_RESERVE_ > _QUOTE_TARGET_ (flipped comparison), altering when _BASE_TARGET_ is set.
Make the function set only _RState_ to ONE when BELOW_ONE and do not update targets (remove assignments to _BASE_TARGET_ and _QUOTE_TARGET_ in first branch).
Make the function set only _RState_ to ONE when ABOVE_ONE and do not update targets (remove assignments to _BASE_TARGET_ and _QUOTE_TARGET_ in second branch).
Insert an extra assignment resetting _BASE_TARGET_ to 0 when BELOW_ONE condition holds, which changes final _BASE_TARGET_.
